Independently reconstructed all fifteen Petersen graph edges, tested all 2^15−1 nonzero edge masks for connected 2-regular support, obtaining cycle counts 12,10,15,20 at lengths 5,6,8,9 and exactly twenty longest 9-cycles. Deduplicated their face down-set to the exact f-vector (15,105,445,1215,2010,1610,720,180,20) with 6320 nonempty faces. Rebuilt the 3110-pair vertex-toggle matching, exhaustively topologically sorted all 32775 oriented Hasse covers (acyclic), with precisely one critical vertex and 99 critical 4-simplices and no other cells. Standard discrete Morse theory then yields a CW wedge of 99 S4, so this is an exact finite homotopy certificate, not merely Betti counts.
